source_graded_roles.gravity_omega: omega=(1/2)*sum_{mu,nu=1}^4 omega^{mu nu} Gamma_{mu nu} with antisymmetric source bivector roles, a connection ONE_FORM
source_graded_roles.electroweak_wew: w_ew source LEFT W^tau and independent RIGHT Pati-Salam B_1^tau, connection ONE_FORM; offdiagonal Wplus/Wminus and B1plus/B1minus source coefficients.
source_graded_roles.frame_e: e=e^mu Gamma_mu is Clifford vector valued ONE_FORM; source original gravitational 4x4 frame has left/right two-by-two spin blocks e_R and e_L
source_graded_roles.higgs_phi: phi=phi^nu GammaPrime_nu with four REAL source scalar components, not a one-form or fermion.
source_graded_roles.ordered_mixed_ephi: e*phi=sum_{mu,nu} e^mu phi^nu Gamma_mu GammaPrime_nu, source order e then phi and graded ONE_FORM result; no commutation or reassociation assumption.
source_graded_roles.source_normalization: Do not drop 1/2 on omega or 1/4 on ordered ephi, and do not identify source omega_L with scalar omega_L^3 or B1 with electroweak W.

source_chiral_embedding.source_statement: Source says H1 may be represented by its POSITIVE-CHIRAL first 8x8 quadrant of 16x16 representation, shown as the printed four-by-four array acting on positive-chiral spinor 8Splus.
source_chiral_embedding.block_entry_carrier: Each row/column slot acts on a source two-component gravitational spinor; omega_L/R and e_L/R denote 2x2 chiral spin operators, gauge W/B1 scalar coefficient entries act as 2x2 identities, so printed 4x4 array has an 8x8 block-matrix action. This is a typed source reconstruction, not proof of a unique 8x8 realification.
source_chiral_embedding.spinor_source_role: Four field-labelled source spinor slots; do not infer equality of physical fermion mass/generation or cross-track spinor identity.
source_chiral_embedding.upper_left_block: gravitational omega_L 2x2 and W SU2_L source coefficients; output left-chiral states
source_chiral_embedding.lower_right_block: gravitational omega_R 2x2 and distinct B1 SU2_R source coefficients; output right-chiral states
source_chiral_embedding.upper_right_block: e_R chiral 2x2 source frame ONE_FORM times four scalar Higgs labels; preserve e_R to LEFT of phi.
source_chiral_embedding.lower_left_block: e_L chiral 2x2 source frame ONE_FORM times four scalar Higgs labels; preserve e_L to LEFT of phi.

displayed_4x4_2x2_field_blocks.source_sign_orientations: All 16 distinct cells in printed row and column order, with top-right e_R vs lower-left e_L, *one explicit source negative sign each* at (1,3) and (3,1); gauge Wplus/Wminus/B1plus/B1minus source coefficients independent.

source_Higgs_labels.reality_guard: phi^mu are four real scalars; phiOne is NOT the real component phi^1; complex conjugate identities require the original real-component domain.

source_frame_and_spin_rules.source_chiral_frame: e_(L/R)=i*(e^4 ± sum_{eps=1}^3 e^eps sigma_eps), upper/RIGHT uses MINUS (e_R), lower/LEFT uses PLUS (e_L); each carries frame 1-form components and acts on spinor two-component carriers.
source_frame_and_spin_rules.source_chiral_spin: omega_(L/R)=(omega_S^tau ∓ i*omega_T^tau)*i*sigma_tau, sum tau=1..3; omega_R=omega_L^{*} only under original REAL gravity connection coefficient domain, not independent new gauge field.
source_frame_and_spin_rules.frame_source_example: e^(eps) spin frame coefficients are ONE_FORMS; any real-sample matrix diagnostic must retain the field domain and cannot prove full field/differential geometry.

important_defect_hazards: The paper says 8x8 chiral source quadrant while printing a 4x4 grid; typing entries as 2x2 spin operators avoids an apparent dimension collision. Do not claim that every entry is a plain complex scalar or assert an independent 4x4=8x8 equality.
omega_L/omega_R are 2x2 gravitational spin matrices, whereas omega_L^3/omega_R^3 in Table5 are Cartan-coordinate components; do not identify them as the same whole operator.
phiOne source is a complex Higgs coordinate, NOT phi^1. Distinguish e_L/e_R chiral frame operators from eT/eS frame time/space source rows in Table5.
